name: beacon-server
description: The Beacon server (NestJS + PostgreSQL), the server-side packages it is built from, and the Atlas place-dataset toolchain. Builds on Beacon's published core packages and presets (@beaconsgg/*).

scripts.test:db: docker compose --profile test up -d --wait db-test && echo "BEACON_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://beacon:beacon@127.0.0.1:${BEACON_TEST_DB_PORT:-55432}/beacon_test"
scripts.gate: pnpm exec beacon-check-coverage-tasks && pnpm exec beacon-check-tier-gate && pnpm run check:copy && pnpm run check:refs && turbo run build typecheck && turbo run test:coverage && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check
